claim: 存在一个精确 DPP（volume sampling）算法，其单次采样成本仅为 poly(d)，与数据行数 n 完全无关——这是负相依/费米子排斥结构在随机数值线性代数中'可证计算优势'的核心资源计数：对 n≫d 的高瘦矩阵，重复采样代价不随数据规模增长。
quote: a sampling step which runs in poly(d) time, independent of the number of rows n

claim: 该算法的一次性预处理步骤在输入稀疏度时间 O(nnz(X)·log n)+poly(d) 内完成，即预处理近线性于矩阵非零元个数，这给出 DPP 采样端到端复杂度的可验证上界（可与后续文献如 Calandriello/Derezinski 2020+ 的改进对比核查）。
quote: a preprocessing step which runs in time O(number-of-non-zeros(X)·log n)+poly(d)

claim: 中间分布（regularized DPP, R-DPP）将行数从 n 降到 poly(d) 且不引入任何分布失真——即这是精确采样而非近似采样，目标 DPP 概率被严格保持；这一'distortion-free'性质是区分'有定理支撑'与'量子启发营销'的关键判据之一。
quote: Crucially, this intermediate distribution does not distort the probabilities of the target sample.

claim: R-DPP 的构造依赖用 Poisson 随机变量控制子集大小的概率，并由此导出新的行列式恒等式（如该分布的归一化常数）——即行列式结构本身提供了可解析计算的配分函数，这是行列式/费米子结构相对一般点过程的具体数学杠杆。
quote: Our key novelty in defining the R-DPP is the use of a Poisson random variable for controlling the probabilities of different subset sizes, leading to new determinantal formulas such as the normalization constant for this distribution.

claim: 作者主张该快速 DPP 采样算法适用于机器学习、随机优化、数据摘要与低秩矩阵重构等领域——此为应用广度主张（摘要层面为声明性，具体每个领域的优势需在正文/后续文献中核实定理条件）。
quote: Our algorithm has applications in many diverse areas where determinantal point processes have been used, such as machine learning, stochastic optimization, data summarization and low-rank matrix reconstruction.

claim: 该论文肯定回答了此前悬而未决的核心问题：DPP 采样构造的 coreset 在基数(cardinality)上可以被证明地小于独立采样构造的 coreset，即费米子型负相依排斥结构在 coreset 选择上有定理级(而非仅实证)优势。
quote: the central question of whether the cardinality of a DPP-based coreset is fundamentally smaller than one based on independent sampling remained open. In this paper, we answer this question in the affirmative, demonstrating that DPPs can provably outperform independently drawn coresets.

claim: 论文将 coreset 损失重新表述为随机 coreset 的线性统计量(linear statistic)，并借此建立了超越已有最优结果的 DPP 线性统计量集中不等式，其适用范围覆盖一般非投影(non-projection)甚至非对称(non-symmetric)核——即定理条件不再局限于经典的投影 DPP。
quote: we contribute a conceptual understanding of coreset loss as a linear statistic of the (random) coreset. We leverage this structural observation to connect the coresets problem to a more general problem of concentration phenomena for linear statistics of DPPs, wherein we obtain effective concentration inequalities that extend well-beyond the state-of-the-art, encompassing general non-projection, even non-symmetric kernels.

claim: 非对称核 DPP 近年已在 coreset 之外的机器学习场景中显示价值，但其理论工具箱有限；该论文的集中不等式是对这一工具箱的扩展——这界定了该结果的适用边界主张(非对称核此前缺乏此类保证)。
quote: The latter have been recently shown to be of interest in machine learning beyond coresets, but come with a limited theoretical toolbox, to the extension of which our result contributes.

claim: 论文声称首次在 coreset 文献中处理了向量值目标函数(vector-valued objective functions)的 coreset 问题。
quote: Finally, we are also able to address the coresets problem for vector-valued objective functions, a novelty in the coresets literature.

claim: 该工作是同行评审结果而非仅预印本：被 NeurIPS 2024 接收且为 Spotlight 论文（作者 Bardenet/Ghosh/Simon-Onfroy/Tran，按字母序排列），可作为'DPP 负相依优势有定理支撑'一类主张的同行评审级引用。
quote: Accepted at NeurIPS 2024 (Spotlight Paper). Authors are listed in alphabetical order

claim: DPP 采样对最小二乘回归给出精确无偏估计量：若子集 S 按 d-DPP（核为 XX^T）采样，则子问题解 X_S^{-1}y_S 的期望恰等于全数据最小二乘解 w*（这是 i.i.d./leverage-score 采样不具备的性质，直接支撑'负相依结构带来统计优势'的论点）。
quote: If S∼d-DPP_L(XX^T), then 𝔼[X_S^{-1}y_S] = argmin_w ||Xw−y||^2 = w*. ... random sampling with a DPP leads to new kinds of unbiased estimators for least squares, enabling more refined statistical and inferential understanding of these algorithms

claim: DPP 最小二乘估计量的期望损失有精确闭式且常数最优：𝔼[L(X_S^{-1}y_S)] = (d+1)·L(w*)，且 (d+1) 因子在一般情形下不可改进——这是一个带匹配下界的定理级主张，而非渐近界。
quote: 𝔼[L(X_S^{-1}y_S)] = (d+1)L(w*), and factor d+1 cannot in general be improved.

claim: leverage score 采样可被推导为投影 DPP 的边缘分布，且丢弃 DPP 的负相关性要付出 log d 倍样本代价：投影 DPP 只需 d 个样本达到 i.i.d. leverage-score 采样需要 d·log d 行才能达到的保证——负相依的计算/统计优势被精确量化为 log 因子。
quote: a RandNLA technique called leverage score sampling can be derived as the marginal distribution of a DPP ... Projection DPP generates only d samples [vs.] leverage score sampling requires d log d rows ... losing negative correlations costs us log d in sample size

claim: DPP 对低秩逼近/Nyström 方法是最坏情形最优的随机算法：列子集选择满足 𝔼[Er(S)] ≤ (1+ε)||X_(r)−X||_F^2 且样本量 r+r/ε−1 为最坏情形最优；Nyström 版本有相应 (1+ε) 迹范数保证。
quote: 𝔼[Er(S)] ≤ (1+ϵ)||X_(r)−X||_F^2, and size r+r/ϵ−1 is worst-case optimal. ... a DPP is, in some sense, an optimal randomized algorithm for the Nyström method

claim: DPP 采样的算法开销已被压到接近标准 RandNLA：中间采样（intermediate sampling）技术把 DPP 采样降为 n·poly(k)·polylog(n) 预处理加 poly(k) 单次采样——DPP 方法'只是适度更贵'而非不可行，这是把费米子式排斥结构实际用于 ML 工具箱的可行性论据。
quote: First sample in: n·poly(k)polylog(n) time, then S_2 in: poly(k) time. ... while not quite as efficient as standard RandNLA techniques, DPP-based algorithms are only moderately more expensive.

publishDate: 2025-02-11 (v1); latest revision v4 2025-11-14; arXiv preprint, no journal reference listed
claim: DPP-based Monte Carlo quadrature has a proven theorem (Theorem 4.1) that for C^1 functions on the hypercube the estimator variance decays as O(N^{-(1+1/d)}), strictly faster than the O(N^{-1}) rate of i.i.d. sampling — a theorem-backed (not merely quantum-inspired) statistical advantage of fermionic/determinantal repulsion.

publishDate: 2025-02-11 (v1); latest revision v4 2025-11-14; arXiv preprint, no journal reference listed
claim: For SGD/coreset minibatch sampling, the paper states a theorem (Theorem 6.4) that DPP-sampled minibatches achieve loss-estimator variance O_P(m^{-(1+1/d)}) versus O(m^{-1}) for independent sampling, i.e. negative dependence improves the variance decay rate in the exponent, while the DPP coreset estimator remains unbiased (E[L_S(f)] = L(f)).
quote: Var[L_{𝒮_DPP}(θ)|𝒳]=O_P(m^{−(1+1/d)}) ... sampling with DPPs improves the decay rate of the variance in the exponent

publishDate: 2025-02-11 (v1); latest revision v4 2025-11-14; arXiv preprint, no journal reference listed
claim: The computational cost boundary of exact DPP sampling is dominated by the O(N^3) eigendecomposition of the kernel matrix, with tree-based algorithms reducing per-sample cost to O(log N) after preprocessing — the key resource count for whether determinantal structure is a burden or a lever in classical ML pipelines.
quote: the true bottleneck here is accessing the eigendecomposition of 𝐋, which required 𝒪(N³) operations

publishDate: 2025-02-11 (v1); latest revision v4 2025-11-14; arXiv preprint, no journal reference listed
claim: The review's overarching claim is that negatively dependent systems (DPPs, strongly Rayleigh measures, perturbed lattices, zeros of random functions) often outperform independence-based methods across optimization, sampling, dimensionality reduction and sparse signal recovery, and that DPPs originate in quantum (fermionic) theory — this is the direct literature bridge from fermionic repulsion structure to classical ML advantages.
quote: Recent developments have evidenced support towards negatively dependent systems as a learning paradigm in a broad range of fundamental machine learning challenges including optimization, sampling, dimensionality reduction and sparse signal recovery, often surpassing the performance of current methods based on statistical independence. The most popular negatively dependent model has been that of determinantal point processes (DPPs), which have their origins in quantum theory.

publishDate: 2025-02-11 (v1); latest revision v4 2025-11-14; arXiv preprint, no journal reference listed
claim: The paper presents new (previously unpublished, preprint-only) results applying DPPs to parsimonious representation / pruning of neural networks, extending determinantal diversity from data sampling into neural architecture compression — relevant to the '行列式结构在特征选择/网络结构中的应用' question but not yet peer-reviewed.
quote: We also present new results on applications of DPPs to the parsimonious representation of neural networks.

claim: 存在非独立同分布(non-i.i.d.)的输入点采样方式，使得无论响应模型是什么，最小二乘解都是最优线性预测器的严格无偏估计——而标准 i.i.d. 随机设计下的最小二乘估计几乎总是有偏的。这直接支撑'DPP/负相依采样在随机数值线性代数中有已证明的统计优势(无偏性)'这一主张。
quote: Unfortunately, this estimator almost always incurs an undesirable bias coming from the randomness of the input points, which is a significant bottleneck in model averaging. In this paper we show that it is possible to draw a non-i.i.d. sample of input points such that, regardless of the response model, the least squares solution is an unbiased estimator of the optimum.

claim: 定量资源计数：对任意输入分布和任意 ε>0，存在由 O(d log d + d/ε) 个点组成的随机设计，从中可构造无偏估计量，其在整个分布上的期望平方损失被 (1+ε) 倍最优损失所界——即无偏性与近最优损失可同时以近线性于维度 d 的样本量达成。
quote: for any input distribution and ε>0 there is a random design consisting of O(d log d+ d/ε) points from which an unbiased estimator can be constructed whose expected square loss over the entire distribution is bounded by 1+ε times the loss of the optimum.

claim: 实现无偏性的机制是行列式点过程：将已有 i.i.d. 样本增补 d 个联合抽取的点，其联合分布为输入分布按点集张成体积的平方重新加权(volume-rescaled DPP)——行列式/费米子式排斥结构是无偏性的构造性来源，而非营销类比。
quote: this sample can be produced efficiently by augmenting a previously drawn i.i.d. sample with an additional set of d points, drawn jointly according to a certain determinantal point process constructed from the input distribution rescaled by the squared volume spanned by the points.

claim: 计算可行性主张：在固定设计矩阵(n≫d 行)场景下，该文给出首个可在近线性于数据规模的时间内构造的无偏最小二乘估计量，所用新技术 distortion-free intermediate sampling 是首个使 DPP 采样时间只随样本量 k 多项式增长(而非随 n 高阶增长)的方法——把 DPP 的统计优势变成计算上可负担的。
quote: we obtain the first unbiased least squares estimator that can be constructed in time nearly-linear in the data size, resulting in strong guarantees for model averaging. We achieve these computational gains by introducing a new algorithmic technique, called distortion-free intermediate sampling, which is the first method to enable sampling from determinantal point processes in time polynomial in the sample size.

claim: 无偏性的下游应用价值有实验支撑：在 d=5 高斯输入+非线性响应的实验中，i.i.d. 采样的最小二乘估计在任何样本量 k 下都有偏，模型平均不收敛到最优；而 DPP 增补的无偏估计量做模型平均时估计误差以 1/T 速率收敛到零(与 k 无关)。适用条件(正文明确)：仅需二阶矩有界 E[||x||²]<∞、E[y²]<∞ 且 E[xx^T] 可逆，不假设线性响应模型。
quote: The i.i.d. sampled estimator is biased for any sample size (although the bias decreases with k), and therefore the averaged estimator clearly does not converge to the optimum. We next discuss how to construct an unbiased estimator (dashed blue curves), for which the estimation error of the averaged estimator exhibits 1/T convergence to zero (regardless of k).

claim: 存在经典模拟算法，可高效模拟作用于非高斯初态上的费米子线性光学（matchgate/高斯）操作，其复杂度对费米子数、目标精度、以及刻画初态非高斯程度的量（如 fermionic Gaussian extent）均为多项式——即模拟代价由'费米子魔法/非高斯性'资源量控制，为经典可模拟边界给出定量定理。
quote: We propose efficient algorithms for classically simulating fermionic linear optics operations applied to non-Gaussian initial states. ... It yields simulation algorithms with polynomial complexity in the number of fermions, the desired accuracy, and certain quantities capturing the degree of non-Gaussianity of the initial state.

claim: 通过 gadget 构造，该结果从'非高斯初态'扩展到'含非高斯门的费米子线性光学电路'的模拟，即 matchgate 电路 + 非高斯资源注入的模拟代价定理：非高斯门可折算为非高斯初态资源。
quote: By gadget constructions, this provides algorithms for fermionic linear optics with non-Gaussian operations.

claim: 该问题与'Clifford 电路 + 非 stabilizer 初态'的模拟在形式上同构：stabilizer 框架下的模拟算法可直接迁移到费米子设定——这为费米子非高斯性与 magic（非稳定子性）两套资源理论的平行性提供了直接文献支撑（而非类比外推）。
quote: We argue that this problem is analogous to that of simulating Clifford circuits with non-stabilizer initial states: Algorithms for the latter problem immediately translate to the fermionic setting.

claim: 技术核心是协方差矩阵形式化的扩展，使得高斯态叠加中的相对相位可被高效追踪——这是标准高斯态（二次哈密顿量基态）模拟工具箱无法处理叠加相位这一缺口的形式化修补。
quote: Our construction is based on an extension of the covariance matrix formalism which permits to efficiently track relative phases in superpositions of Gaussian states.

claim: 费米子 Gaussian extent（模拟代价的度量）在张量积上的乘性并非无条件成立：论文证明当 fermionic Gaussian fidelity 具乘性时 extent 也乘性，且只对'两个任意四费米子正宇称纯态的张量积'这一受限情形建立了该性质——适用边界明确，一般情形仍开放。
quote: We study one such quantity, the fermionic Gaussian extent, and show that it is multiplicative on tensor products when the so-called fermionic Gaussian fidelity is. We establish this property for the tensor product of two arbitrary pure states of four fermions with positive parity.

claim: 存在一个经典模拟算法：对由自由的近邻 matchgate/费米子线性光学（FLO）门加上非高斯'资源'门组成的通用量子电路，估计 Born 规则概率的运行时间对所有电路参数均为多项式，唯一例外是对新引入的'FLO extent'量呈线性依赖，而该量随受控相位门数量呈指数增长——这为 matchgate+非高斯资源注入划定了经典可模拟边界的定量形式（模拟代价由非高斯资源量而非电路规模主导）。
quote: The runtime cost of our algorithm for estimating the Born-rule probability of a given quantum circuit scales polynomially in all circuit parameters, except for a linear dependence on the newly introduced FLO extent, which scales exponentially with the number of controlled-phase gates.

claim: 通过对相关资源态求最优分解，该算法的模拟代价每增加一个'最大资源性'门（如 swap 或 CZ 门）恰好翻倍（×2），即代价为 O(2^k)——这是一个具体可核验的资源计数结果。
quote: More precisely, as a result of finding optimal decompositions of relevant resource states, the runtime doubles for every maximally resourceful (e.g., swap or CZ) gate added.

claim: 相对此前最优算法（每个 swap 门使模拟代价增加约 9 倍），对含任意 FLO 幺正和 k 个 CZ 门的电路，该算法取得 O(4.5^k) 的指数级改进。
quote: Crucially, this cost compares very favourably with the best known prior algorithm, where each swap gate increases the simulation cost by a factor of approximately 9. For a quantum circuit containing arbitrary FLO unitaries and k controlled-Z gates, we obtain an exponential improvement O(4.5^k) over the prior state-of-the-art.

claim: 方法学关键：用非高斯资源态对任意相位的受控相位门做 gadget 化即可把可高效模拟的 FLO 子理论提升到通用量子计算，且其新的相位敏感 FLO 模拟算法允许在态矢量层面（而非密度矩阵层面）分解资源态——这是取得改进的机制来源，也说明费米子高斯态的相位信息可以被经典高效追踪。
quote: We achieve the promotion of the efficiently simulable FLO subtheory to universal quantum computation by gadgetizing controlled phase gates with arbitrary phases employing non-Gaussian resource states. Our key contribution is the development of a novel phase-sensitive algorithm for simulating FLO circuits. This allows us to decompose the resource states arising from gadgetization into free states at the level of statevectors rather than density matrices.

claim: 该结果为同行评审发表（非仅预印本）：Quantum 期刊第 8 卷第 1549 页，2024 年 12 月 4 日出版，DOI 10.22331/q-2024-12-04-1549，作者 Oliver Reardon-Smith、Michał Oszmaniec、Kamil Korzekwa。
quote: Quantum, Volume 8, Page 1549 ... DOI: https://doi.org/10.22331/q-2024-12-04-1549 ... Authors: Oliver Reardon-Smith, Michał Oszmaniec, and Kamil Korzekwa ... Publication Date: December 4, 2024

claim: 存在基于流形局部几何的高效梯度下降算法，可在玻色与费米子纯高斯态族上极值化任意目标函数（含局部约束的实现），即费米子高斯态流形支持连续参数化下的通用局部优化。
quote: We exploit insights into the geometry of bosonic and fermionic Gaussian states to develop an efficient local optimization algorithm to extremize arbitrary functions on these families of states. The method is based on notions of gradient descent attuned to the local geometry which also allows for the implementation of local constraints.

claim: 几何梯度的高效计算依赖高斯态流形上的自然群作用：玻色情形为辛群、费米情形为正交群——这正是费米子线性光学连续群结构（O(2N) 作用）被用作优化杠杆的直接文献支撑。
quote: The natural group action of the symplectic and orthogonal group enables us to compute the geometric gradient efficiently.

claim: 以协方差矩阵与线性复结构（linear complex structures）为态参数化基础，并给出与其他常用高斯态参数化（纯态波函数、准概率分布、Bogoliubov 变换）之间的紧凑互换公式，即不同连续参数化之间可显式转换。
quote: While our parametrization of states is based on covariance matrices and linear complex structures, we provide compact formulas to easily convert from and to other parametrization of Gaussian states, such as wave functions for pure Gaussian states, quasiprobability distributions and Bogoliubov transformations.

claim: 该优化框架的已验证应用范围包括基态近似（变分优化）、电路复杂度计算与纠缠纯化度（entanglement of purification）计算——即高斯态流形优化在变分算法语境中的具体用例清单。
quote: We review applications ranging from approximating ground states to computing circuit complexity and the entanglement of purification that have both been employed in the context of holography.

claim: 论文给出数值与解析证据支持一个可证伪猜想：对任意混合高斯态，高斯纯化（Gaussian purifications）即足以计算其纠缠纯化度（无需超出高斯族的纯化态）。
quote: Finally, we use the presented methods to collect numerical and analytical evidence for the conjecture that Gaussian purifications are sufficient to compute the entanglement of purification of arbitrary mixed Gaussian states.

claim: HATT（Hamiltonian-Adaptive Ternary Tree）通过针对具体费米子哈密顿量自适应构造 ternary tree 映射，相比 Jordan-Wigner、Bravyi-Kitaev、balanced ternary tree 等构造式基线，在多种费米子体系的模拟中将 Pauli weight、门数与电路深度降低约 5–20%（细分数字：Pauli weight 约 −15%，电路深度 −5~20%，CNOT 门数 −10~30%）。
quote: Evaluations and simulations of various Fermionic systems demonstrate 5∼20% reduction in Pauli weight, gate count, and circuit depth, alongside excellent scalability to larger systems.

claim: HATT 的映射构造算法复杂度从 O(N⁴) 降到 O(N³)（N 为费米子模式数），手段是对树结构加缓存使遍历从最坏 O(N) 降到 O(1)，且优化过程保持 vacuum state preservation 性质（费米子真空态映射到全零量子比特态）而不增加搜索复杂度。
quote: our optimizations retain the important vacuum state preservation property in our Fermion-to-qubit mapping and reduce the complexity of our algorithm from O(N⁴) to O(N³)

claim: 与 SAT 求解器做穷举最优的 Fermihedral 相比：HATT 在小规模上给出接近最优的映射，而 Fermihedral 因 SAT 的固有困难无法扩展到大规模实际案例；在 Fermihedral 只能给近似最优解的更大规模上，HATT 的多项式时间构造反而胜出——这为『定制编码的最优性 vs 可扩展性』权衡提供了具体资源计数证据。
quote: Fermihedral "fails to accommodate large-size practical cases" due to "SAT's intrinsic hardness" … HATT generates "close-to-optimal mappings for small-size cases compared with optimal mapping from Fermihedral" … "even outperforms the approximately optimal solutions"

claim: 在 IonQ Forte 1 离子阱量子计算机上的真机实验中，HATT 映射的量子模拟结果方差最小（噪声抗性最好），平均值居第二，仅次于 Fermihedral 的最优映射——即编码层面的 Pauli weight 优化在真实含噪硬件上可转化为可测量的噪声抗性优势。
quote: HATT achieves the smallest variance and the second best average result (the best average result comes from Fermihedral's optimal mapping).

claim: 该工作已通过同行评审：被 2025 IEEE International Symposium on High Performance Computer Architecture (HPCA) 接收，属计算机体系结构顶会，故其资源计数结论可标注为同行评审结果而非纯预印本主张。
quote: Journal reference: 2025 IEEE International Symposium on High Performance Computer Architecture (HPCA)

claim: 在量子比特系统上,编码非局域费米子统计需要额外资源开销(JW 编码下模拟隧穿门需要 O(L) 个纠缠门),而本文提出的中性原子费米子处理器把费米模型局部编码进费米寄存器,用费米门以硬件高效方式实现常数深度——这是'原生费米统计免去编码开销'主张的直接定量支撑。
quote: tunneling gates, required to simulate many-body fermionic systems, can be implemented in the case of a JW encoding using 𝒪(L) entangling gates. In contrast, their fermionic approach achieves constant depth.

claim: 配对隧穿门(pair-tunneling)与密度依赖隧穿门在费米硬件上可用固定的 5 个门、常数电路深度精确且最优地实现,相对 JW 变换得到的电路在深度上有明确优势——这是一条可核对的资源计数主张(具体门数与'exact and optimal'限定条件)。
quote: constant circuit depth of 5 gates and are exact and optimal. This provides a clear advantage in terms of depth with respect to the circuit obtained using e.g. JW transformations.

claim: 费米统计在硬件层面被保证:囚禁于光镊运动基态的费米原子直接实现门集 𝒢(含非局域隧穿门),通过原子全同性而非软件编码来保证费米反对易关系,从而'免去'JW 串开销。这直接回应缺口四中'原生费米子统计免去编码开销'的优势论证。
quote: Fermionic atoms trapped in the motional ground state of optical tweezers offer the unique possibility to avoid this overhead by implementing the gate set 𝒢 directly.

claim: 该工作是理论提案而非完整费米量子处理器的实验实现,但其中的相互作用门 𝒰ᵢⱼ^(int)(θ) 已经在碱金属与碱土金属原子中用 Rydberg 阻塞机制实验实现过——因此'当前实验状态'应界定为:构件级已有实验,整机架构为提案(提交 2023-03-13,PNAS 2023 发表)。
quote: The interaction gate 𝒰ᵢⱼ⁽ⁱⁿᵗ⁾(θ) has already been implemented for alkaline and alkaline-earth atoms using the Rydberg blockade mechanism.

claim: 该架构给出了具体应用示例:对 LiH 分子的变分量子本征求解(VQE)以及格点规范理论(LGT)的 Trotter 步——后者因并行化与'消除 JW 串'实现常数电路深度;作者声称对更大分子的优势随轨道数增长(留待后续工作),此为外推性预期而非本文已验证结果。
quote: the lack of JW strings ... A detailed study for larger molecules...where the advantage...is expected to grow with the number of orbitals, will be included in a separate work.

claim: 对二维 N 格点费米子晶格上的所有几何局域相互作用，存在一种费米子-量子比特（F2Q）编码方案，可在同尺寸量子比特晶格上模拟，相互作用数量无渐近开销、空间（比特数）零开销——即无需辅助比特，每个费米模式恰好一个 qubit，这是通过动态重定向 Jordan-Wigner 编码（在互补的 boustrophedon 排序间切换）实现的。
quote: We show how to simulate all geometrically local interactions on an N-site two-dimensional fermion lattice with no asymptotic overhead in the number of interactions and no space overhead. ... This is enabled by dynamically reorienting the Jordan-Wigner transformation to switch the lattice dimension along which locality is preserved.

claim: 该方案的代价集中在电路深度上，且深度随硬件架构分档：普通二维量子比特晶格上为 O(√N)（与费米子交换网络 FSN 持平、受光锥下界约束），可重构量子比特阵列（如中性原子）上降至 O(log N)，基于 lattice-surgery 的表面码容错架构中降至 O(1)。这为'编码开销'给出了架构依赖的精确边界条件。
quote: The primary overhead of our method is circuit depth, which on a qubit lattice matches that of fermionic swap networks, scaling as O(√N), but reduces to O(log N) on reconfigurable qubit arrays and to O(1) in lattice-surgery-based surface-code architectures.

claim: 论文明确量化了原生费米子量子处理器相对于 qubit 处理器的优势基线：标准 JW+FSN 方法模拟二维费米晶格需要 O(N^{3/2}) 局域相互作用和 O(√N) 深度，相对无需 F2Q 映射的费米子处理器（O(N) 相互作用、O(1) 深度）存在 O(√N) 开销——而本文的构造将相互作用数量差距消除，把原生费米子硬件的剩余优势收窄为纯深度优势（且在容错架构下连深度优势也消失）。这直接约束了'原生费米统计免编码开销'论证的适用范围。
quote: simulating two-dimensional fermion lattices using standard JW-based swap-network constructions requires O(N^{3/2}) local interactions and O(√N) depth, even on two-dimensional qubit lattices. This represents an O(√N) overhead relative to fermionic quantum processors, which, lacking the need for an F2Q mapping, can achieve the same simulation with O(N) local interactions at O(1) depth.

claim: 给出了可验证的具体资源计数：任意 boustrophedon 编码间切换的两比特门数上界 C < 6N + O(√N)、深度上界 T < 6√N + O(1)；Fermi-Hubbard 二阶 Trotter 步的门数为方晶格 NN 21N / NNN 30N / Lieb 19⅔N / Kagome 24N（深度 4√(N/2) 或 12√(N/6)）；数值上在 5×5 晶格（含自旋共 50 qubits）即已比标准 FSN 门数更低，深度上超过 7×7 晶格后优于 FSN。
quote: any boustrophedon-to-boustrophedon transformation can be realized with a two-qubit gate count bounded by C < 6N + O(√N) and depth bounded by T < 6√N + O(1). ... our scaling advantage already yields lower gate counts for 5 × 5 lattices, which correspond to a total of 50 qubits considering both spin species. ... the significant smaller prefactor in our approach allows it to outperform FSNs for lattices larger than 7 × 7.

claim: 作为应用，费米子快速傅里叶变换（FFFT）在无辅助比特的二维量子比特晶格上达到局域连接约束下的渐近最优资源：门数 O(N^{3/2})、深度 O(√N)，优于 Constantinides et al. 的 O(N^{3/2} log²N)/O(√N log²N) 和 Givens 旋转的 O(N²)/O(N)；且所有构造推广到 d 维晶格（深度 O(N^{1/d})），费米子路由渐近匹配 qubit 路由的资源标度。
quote: This allows the fermionic fast Fourier transform to be implemented on qubit lattices with asymptotically optimal resource scaling under these locality constraints. ... When using qubit lattices, we reach resource scaling that asymptotically matches that of qubit routing ... Notably, all of our constructions naturally extend to d-dimensional lattices.

publishDate: 2012-07-25 (arXiv v1; last revised 2013-01-10; published in Foundations and Trends in Machine Learning, Vol. 5, No. 2-3, pp. 123-286, 2012)
claim: DPP 的全套概率推断(采样、边缘化、条件化、归一化)存在高效且精确的算法,而一般含负相关的结构化模型(如 MRF)推断是 NP-hard 且难以近似——即费米子型行列式排斥结构是唯一已知的、全局负相关下仍完全可 tractable 的概率模型族,这是缺口三'费米子结构的已证计算优势'的核心定理级主张。
quote: In contrast to traditional structured models like Markov random fields, which become intractable and hard to approximate in the presence of negative correlations, DPPs offer efficient and exact algorithms for sampling, marginalization, conditioning, and other inference tasks.

publishDate: 2012-07-25 (arXiv v1; last revised 2013-01-10; published in Foundations and Trends in Machine Learning, Vol. 5, No. 2-3, pp. 123-286, 2012)
claim: 精确 DPP 采样的具体资源计数:Hough et al. (2006) 算法在给定核的特征分解后以 O(N·k³) 时间采样(k 为选中的特征向量数),瓶颈是一次性的 O(N³) 特征分解;归一化常数有闭式 det(L+I)。这给出了行列式结构'可精确采样'主张的适用边界——N³ 缩放在 N≈10⁴ 量级即成为实际瓶颈。
quote: Algorithm 1 runs in time O(N k³), where k = |V| is the number of eigenvectors selected in phase one. ... In practice, the initial eigendecomposition of L is often the computational bottleneck, requiring O(N³) time. Modern multi-core machines can compute eigendecompositions up to N ≈ 1,000 at interactive speeds of a few seconds, or larger problems up to N ≈ 10,000 in around ten minutes.

publishDate: 2012-07-25 (arXiv v1; last revised 2013-01-10; published in Foundations and Trends in Machine Learning, Vol. 5, No. 2-3, pp. 123-286, 2012)
claim: 失效边界的定理:DPP 的 MAP/众数问题(max_Y det(L_Y))是 NP-hard,且 NP-hard 到近似因子 8/9+ε(Theorem 2.9,从 exact 3-cover 归约,基于 Ko et al. 1995 与 Çivril & Magdon-Ismail 2009);即行列式结构的可解性优势只覆盖'概率推断',不覆盖'最优子集选择'——后者只能在基数约束下多项式时间常数因子近似。
quote: Finding the mode of a DPP—that is, finding the set Y ⊆ Y that maximizes P_L(Y)—is NP-hard. ... although the MAP problem for DPPs is NP-hard, it can be approximated to a constant factor under cardinality constraints in polynomial time.

publishDate: 2012-07-25 (arXiv v1; last revised 2013-01-10; published in Foundations and Trends in Machine Learning, Vol. 5, No. 2-3, pp. 123-286, 2012)
claim: DPP 与费米子的连接是字面等价而非'量子启发'类比:Macchi (1975) 将其命名为'fermion processes',因为 DPP 精确给出热平衡下费米子系统的分布,泡利不相容原理导致的反聚束效应恰好由 DPP 描述——这为最终报告区分'有直接文献支撑的连接'与'类比外推'提供了锚点。
quote: Determinantal point processes (DPPs) were first identified as a class by Macchi [1975], who called them "fermion processes" because they give the distributions of fermion systems at thermal equilibrium. The Pauli exclusion principle states that no two fermions can occupy the same quantum state; as a consequence fermions exhibit what is known as the "anti-bunching" effect. This repulsion is described precisely by a DPP.

publishDate: 2012-07-25 (arXiv v1; last revised 2013-01-10; published in Foundations and Trends in Machine Learning, Vol. 5, No. 2-3, pp. 123-286, 2012)
claim: 低秩对偶表示打破 O(N³) 瓶颈:当核可写为 L = BᵀB(B 为 D×N,D≪N)时,D×D 对偶核 C = BBᵀ 足以完成几乎全部 DPP 推断——归一化与边缘化对 N 是常数时间,采样对 N 是线性时间;这是行列式结构在大规模 ML 应用中实际可用的关键算法条件。
quote: C is sufficient to perform nearly all forms of DPP inference efficiently, including normalization and marginalization in constant time with respect to N, and sampling in time linear in N.

publishDate: 2020-04-02 (arXiv v1; v4 2020-11-07; 期刊发表 SciPost Phys. 9, 048, 2020, 同行评审)
claim: 论文建立了一个系统的几何框架,把变分量子方法(实时演化、激发谱、谱函数、虚时演化四类任务)统一表述为选定变分流形上的连续几何/动力学问题,其覆盖的变分族明确包括高斯态与群论相干态——这正是'费米子高斯态流形上的连续参数化/优化'的形式化基础。
quote: We present a systematic geometric framework to study closed quantum systems based on suitably chosen variational families. For the purpose of (A) real time evolution, (B) excitation spectra, (C) spectral functions and (D) imaginary time evolution... These go from Gaussian states and group theoretic coherent states to generalized Gaussian states.

publishDate: 2020-04-02 (arXiv v1; v4 2020-11-07; 期刊发表 SciPost Phys. 9, 048, 2020, 同行评审)
claim: 可检验的形式化边界:传统变分方法(如 TDVP 各种投影形式的等价性)要求变分流形是 Kähler 流形(乘以虚数单位 i 保持切空间不变);而'广义高斯态'这类新变分族是非 Kähler 的,必须区别处理——这给出了高斯态流形连续优化方法适用/失效的判据。
quote: Traditional variational methods typically require the variational family to be a Kähler manifold, where multiplication by the imaginary unit preserves the tangent spaces. This covers the vast majority of cases studied in the literature. However, recently proposed classes of generalized Gaussian states make it necessary to also include the non-Kähler case, which has already been encountered occasionally.

publishDate: 2020-04-02 (arXiv v1; v4 2020-11-07; 期刊发表 SciPost Phys. 9, 048, 2020, 同行评审)
claim: 失效条件的机制说明:在非 Kähler 流形上,薛定谔方程存在两种不等价的变分投影(在复向量空间上两者只差一个因子 i、故等价;非 Kähler 流形的切空间只是实向量空间而非复向量空间,等价性破坏)——即 Lagrangian/McLachlan 型变分原理在非 Kähler 情形分叉,连续演化方程不唯一。
quote: there exist two inequivalent projections of Schrödinger's equation...which are obviously equivalent on a complex vector space, as the two forms only differ by a factor of i. However, the defining property of a non-Kähler manifold is precisely that its tangent space is not a complex, but merely a real vector space

publishDate: 2020-04-02 (arXiv v1; v4 2020-11-07; 期刊发表 SciPost Phys. 9, 048, 2020, 同行评审)
claim: 对 ML 可迁移性最直接的实证弹药:变分流形上的虚时演化被证明恰是关于流形度量 G 的梯度下降流 dx^μ/dτ = −G^{μν} ∂_ν E(x),且该流单调降低能量——即量子高斯态(含费米子高斯态)基态优化在数学上就是黎曼度量下的自然梯度下降(与 ML 中 natural gradient 结构相同,此连接有直接文献支撑而非类比外推)。

publishDate: 2021 (SciPost Phys. Core 4, 025); arXiv v1 2020-10-29, v4 revised 2024-11-30
claim: 纯高斯态（玻色与费米统一）可由经典相空间上的线性复结构 J 唯一刻画，等价于相容 Kähler 三元组 (G, Ω, J) 且 J² = −1；混合高斯态对应 J² ≠ −1 的三元组——这给出费米子高斯态流形的连续参数化，超越传统协方差矩阵方法。
quote: We show that bosonic and fermionic Gaussian states (also known as "squeezed coherent states") can be uniquely characterized by their linear complex structure J which is a linear map on the classical phase space. ... Pure Gaussian states can be identified with the triple (G,Ω,J) of compatible Kähler structures, consisting of a positive definite metric G, a symplectic form Ω and a linear complex structure J with J²=−1. Mixed Gaussian states can also be identified with such a triple, but with J²≠−1.

publishDate: 2021 (SciPost Phys. Core 4, 025); arXiv v1 2020-10-29, v4 revised 2024-11-30

quote: the orthogonal group O(2N,ℝ)={M∈GL(2N,ℝ)|MGM⊺=G} ... the symplectic group Sp(2N,ℝ)={M∈GL(2N,ℝ)|MΩM⊺=Ω} ... U(N)={M∈𝒢|[M,J]=0}

publishDate: 2021 (SciPost Phys. Core 4, 025); arXiv v1 2020-10-29, v4 revised 2024-11-30
claim: 该 Kähler 参数化被明确接入连续优化：姊妹工作把高斯态作为 Kähler 流形上变分方法的首要范例，并有配套工作在这些流形上求可微函数的局部极值、系统综述多种参数化——即费米子高斯态流形上的连续参数化/优化有直接文献支撑，非类比外推。

([2020]) to find local extrema of differentiable functions on these manifolds, for which a large number of different parametrizations is reviewed.

publishDate: 2021 (SciPost Phys. Core 4, 025); arXiv v1 2020-10-29, v4 revised 2024-11-30
claim: 玻色/费米对偶的精确结构区分：玻色情形辛形式 Ω 是典范的（由泊松括号决定）而度规 G 依赖于态；费米情形恰好相反，度规 G 是典范的（由反对易关系决定）而辛形式依赖于态。
quote: For bosons, the symplectic form Ωab is canonical and determined by the classical Poisson brackets, while the metric Gab depends on the state. On the other hand, for fermions it is the metric Gab that is canonical.

publishDate: 2021 (SciPost Phys. Core 4, 025); arXiv v1 2020-10-29, v4 revised 2024-11-30
claim: 以复结构 J 表达时，纠缠熵等信息论量对玻色与费米高斯态取相同形式——J 参数化统一了两类统计的可计算量，是'费米子连续性'用法的一个可验证收益（具体公式在论文 IV.1.3 节）。
quote: various expressions for information-theoretic quantities (e.g., the entanglement entropy) take the same form for bosons and fermions when written in terms of the complex structure J
